rationale: Same v13 ledger, same edge-to-edge card, same single-link row with one chevron at the far right. The fixture is now Athletics at Tampa Bay Rays (6:40 PM ET) with nine cappers sorted by MLB money at $10 a pick. Title reads "Capper Database"; the subline drops the freeze note and states the basis (9 cappers, MLB record, $10 a pick). Count-strip pill text takes the host ink tokens (ATH away, TB home, Over, Under) while the All pill stays neutral and the active highlight (surface2 fill plus the inset shadow) is unchanged. The source badge is pinned to the name line: the ident row no longer wraps and the badge has flex-shrink 0, so it can never fall under the name. Names render at 15px, 13px past 12 characters, and the one allowed truncation is written into the html (KnightDasCapita...), with the full name in the aria-label. The third line carries the recorded time, then the Small sample chip, the streak chip, and the two new season badges (sb-money, sb-record) as neutral pills. No color is set on pk-*, src-*, or stk-* classes; the host owns those.
free_tier_notes: Free tier sees the same list. Names, metrics, the source badge, the season badges and the pick chip stay visible; the row tap routes into the existing paywall flow when the user is not paying. Nothing in the fragment reveals the scoring engine or the source pipeline beyond the sanctioned source badge names.
graded_state_notes: Once the game goes final the same rows stay in place with the same order (MLB money). A graded result would ride the pick column (a W/L/Push mark under the chip) and the tint on the price line, with the metrics line unchanged since it is the MLB record as of the recording time. The count strip counts do not change after first pitch.
